Both supplied units are base-side excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (lines 1-232 and 233-422). No patch, head text or hunk coordinates were provided, so I could not see what this PR changes. This is a coverage limit, not evidence that the change is safe.

The base text is documentation only and has no runtime security behavior. It describes controls that matter to the threat model:
- Legacy MDM cohort freeze and the /v1/enroll proof (TB-009, T-036).
- App Attest requirement for noncohort routing and base rewards (TB-011, T-052..T-054).
- Default-off soft-delete mutation gate and account erasure (T-059).
- Provider-bound caller-field minimization (A-001, T-003).
- Autopilot and daily-floor payments, default off (A-009).
- Review and merge-clearance controls.

The changelog statements are consistent with the canonical context. The one point to confirm is that MDM profile copyability is documented as unchanged (TB-009 current_limitations).

The next pass should inspect the actual patch for CHANGELOG.md and any other files in the PR. It should check that any new claims, such as payment activation, trust gates or erasure behavior, do not overstate the controls (T-052..T-059, A-009), and that code changes match them.
